title: browser eval's script-file read gets a tested decision
notes: GitHub issue #371 (gh issue view 371); the PR body says Closes #371. The eval branch of src/main/browser/browser-program.ts reads the script file and refuses when it can't be read, with no test (pnpm check lists the file as untested; workflow-rule-2). Move that decision into a pure function in browser-cli.ts with a test.
